title: Declare C-family primary execution stack and one-language-one-format convergence
summary: Re-order the governed language stack so C/C++/C# carry primary execution, bound Python to on-demand governance semantics, and declare exactly one canonical authored-source format per language with grandfathered alternates denied for new files.
origin: human-governor directive 2026-09-25: unify file formats (one language one format), optimize for high performance, high execution speed, low consumption and low resource footprint, reduce Python dependency, C/C++/C# primary

problem.summary: The implementation language surface has drifted from the declared stack: TypeScript accumulates .tsx/.d.ts alternates, the C# source roots in policy do not cover the registered .NET tools (business-logic-csharp, process-metrics-csharp), process-metrics-csharp has no architecture registration, and the codex does not yet declare a primary execution order or a single canonical format per language. Python residency also exceeds the bounded on-demand role the stack intends.
problem.codex_state: A35 lists the hybrid stack without a primary execution order; A341 lacks a primary-execution row; A348 lists multi-extension sets per language without primary/grandfathered distinction; A604 assigns language responsibility without declaring the C-family-primary optimization target.
problem.risk_if_unamended: Extension alternates proliferate, the boundary gate cannot enforce a single canonical format, policy roots contradict registered .NET tools, and Python keeps absorbing execution work that the optimization target assigns to C/C++/C#.

changes.proposed: STACK:c11+c++17+csharp+fsharp+python+typescript+sql hybrid; PRIMARY-EXECUTION-ORDER:c11>c++17>csharp; C:approved deterministic rules+permission hot paths+resident runtime+native tests; CPP:object-oriented native capabilities+inference+native tests+approved audit hot paths; CSHARP:interfaces+typed adapters+authorized workflow orchestration+sole test orchestration+Windows .NET integration; FSHARP:data analysis+machine learning+high-correctness complex calculation; PYTHON:on-demand gate adjudication+necessary governance semantics+model research/training+unavoidable boundaries only and nonresident after request completion; TYPESCRIPT:presentation+build-time type safety; SQL:data operations+structured authoritative persistence within declared authority boundaries; OPTIMIZATION-TARGET:high-performance+high-execution-speed+low-consumption+low-resource-footprint+reduced-python-residency; SOLE:allowed-code-architecture

MATRIX:{primary-execution=>owner:C+C++;callers:CSharp adapters+C ABI;deny:Python second execution path}+{system-orchestration=>owner:CSharp;callers:TypeScript+C+++C adapters;deny:adapter second orchestration}+{UI-state-and-presentation=>owner:TypeScript;caller:typed API data provider;deny:backend DOM control}+{Native-ABI=>owner:C;callers:Python+CSharp+pybind11;deny:public C++ ABI}+{high-performance-algorithms=>owner:C++;callers:C ABI and approved bindings only;deny:duplicate authoritative implementation}+{Windows-DotNET=>owner:CSharp;callers:typed adapters+C ABI;deny:CSharp cross-platform domain logic}+{analysis-and-machine-learning=>owner:FSharp;callers:versioned service contracts;deny:FSharp governance+permission+business judgment}+{relational-data-operation=>owner:SQL;caller:application services;deny:fetch-all-then-filter}+{bounded-governance-semantics=>owner:Python;callers:governance adapters;deny:Python resident services}; UNIQUENESS:each capability has exactly one authoritative language owner and callers are adapters/consumers only; CALL-PATH:every cross-language call is typed+versioned+tested; FALLBACK:a fallback preserves behavior but cannot become a second active owner; CHANGE:owner transfer requires successor law+affected graph+atomic migration+old-owner removal+release hard gate.

CORE-ORDER:correctness-first>declared-language-owner>representative reproducible profile>contract and behavior oracle>independent acceptance>certified activation. NEW-FEATURE follows A604: execution modules prefer C/C++ then C#; C11 owns approved deterministic rules,resident runtime and native tests; C++ owns native capabilities,inference,native tests and approved audit hot paths; C# owns interfaces,authorized orchestration,Windows .NET integration and the sole test orchestrator; F# owns analysis,machine learning and high-correctness complex calculation; TypeScript owns presentation; Python is limited to on-demand governance semantics,model research/training and unavoidable boundaries. New execution capability activates through versioned contracts,toolchain evidence,owned tests,resource bounds and failure semantics; no language gains governance,permission or business authority through promotion. Missing or stale evidence,contract drift,failed parity or unsupported platform blocks activation and restores the last verified path.

GRANDFATHERED-ALTERNATES:existing files pinned and reviewable but new authored files denied: python=.pyi;typescript=.tsx,.d.ts;c=.h;cpp=.hpp,.inl;fsharp=.fsx.
